title: Python Developer Lead
company: iBytes Bits and Bots Private Limited

 to support data\-intensive and AI\-enabled applications.

 Partner with product, QA, and infrastructure teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and business\-aligned solutions.
 



  





**Requirements**

 **Experience:** 
**5\+ years** 
 of hands\-on experience in backend development with Python, including experience leading or mentoring development teams.
 



 ·      
 **Frameworks \& APIs:** 
 Strong experience in
 **FastAPI** 
 and designing, developing, and maintaining
 **REST APIs** 
 .
 



 ·      
 **Databases:** 
 Proficiency with

 and exposure to vector databases such as
 **Milvus**

 Practical experience with

 , CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, and automation using
 **Jenkins**

 Good understanding of microservices architecture, scalable system design, debugging, testing, and secure coding practices.

**Key Skills**

title: Senior Mortgage Systems Developer
description:
SWBC is seeking a talented individual to design, develop, integrate, and support enterprise mortgage technology solutions, with emphasis on ICE Encompass LOS, SQL/data development, APIs, workflow automation, reporting, and secure business applications. The role exists to provide senior\-level technical expertise for complex mortgage systems, production support, vendor integrations, and technology modernization efforts that support business operations and compliance\-focused execution.
   

  

**Why You'll Love This Role**
 This senior technical role gives a candidate the opportunity to build, integrate, and support mission\-critical mortgage technology solutions that directly improve operational efficiency, data quality, reporting, and user experience. The position combines deep Encompass LOS expertise, SQL/data development, application development, integration, automation, and emerging technology adoption in a highly collaborative environment.
   

  

**Essential Duties Include The Following**
* Develop, enhance, and support mortgage technology solutions, with primary focus on ICE Encompass LOS and related mortgage systems.
* Design, develop, and maintain SQL Server/T\-SQL objects including stored procedures, functions, views, ETL processes, and operational reporting solutions.
* Design, build, and support API\-driven integrations and workflow automations across mortgage, document, servicing, vendor, and enterprise platforms.
* Develop and maintain secure, scalable business applications using modern software development practices, object\-oriented design, REST APIs, JSON/XML, and .NET/C\# technologies.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root\-cause analysis, tune system/database performance, and coordinate timely resolution across internal teams and third\-party providers.
* Support DevOps, source control, CI/CD, cloud, monitoring, operational support, and infrastructure\-as\-code practices for mortgage technology applications.
* Partner with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions; document design, testing, deployment, and support procedures.
* Identify and implement automation and emerging technology opportunities, including practical use of AI\-assisted development tools to improve efficiency, quality, troubleshooting, and documentation.
* Performs all other duties as assigned.


**Serious Candidates Will Possess The Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Management Information System, or related field from an accredited four\-year college or university required.
* Certified Application Developer preferred.
* Minimum of ten (10\) years of experience to include designing and building applications.
* Experience with mortgage origination systems, preferably ICE Encompass LOS.
* Experience with Encompass APIs, Developer Connect, Data Connect, Partner Connect, and third\-party mortgage technology integrations preferred.
* Understanding of mortgage origination, servicing, document management, and vendor ecosystems.
* Advanced Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL development skills.
* Experience developing stored procedures, functions, views, ETL processes, and enterprise reporting solutions.
* Ability to troubleshoot production issues, optimize queries, and support operational reporting.
* Understanding of database design, data modeling, and data governance principles.
* Strong knowledge of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) and modern software development practices.
* Hands\-on experience with; C\#, .NET / .NET Core, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, REST APIs, JSON/XML
* Experience developing and supporting secure, maintainable business applications.
* Angular, React, and cloud platform experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of DevOps principles, GitHub Enterprise, CI/CD pipelines, AWS cloud services, Infrastructure as Code (CDK with Python), containerization, monitoring, and operational support practices.
* Experience designing and supporting system integrations and workflow automation solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills across multiple systems and platforms.
* Experience integrating mortgage, servicing, document, or vendor platforms preferred.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar technologies to improve development efficiency, code quality, troubleshooting, and documentation.
* Experience identifying and implementing automation opportunities that streamline business processes, enhance reporting, and improve operational effectiveness.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled solutions, API\-driven automation, and emerging technologies that support business and technology objectives.
* Demonstrated willingness to learn and adopt new technologies to improve productivity and deliver business value.
* Understanding of AI\-related concepts and practical business applications preferred.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Strong analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
* Commitment to continuous learning and adoption of emerging technologies.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and time\-management skills.
* Excellent analytical thinking and problem solving skills.
* Able to program in languages such as C\#, Hypertext Markup Language, PowerShell, Java (J2EE) etc.
* Able to sit for long periods of time performing sedentary activities.
* Able to stand, stoop, and kneel to file for long periods of time.
* Able to push, pull, and lift up to 20 lbs. of files, supplies, documents, or other related items.


***SWBC offers\*:***
* Competitive overall compensation package
* Work/Life balance
* Employee engagement activities and recognition awards
* Years of Service awards
* Career enhancement and growth opportunities
* Leadership Academy and Mentor Program
* Continuing education and career certifications
* Variety of healthcare coverage options
* Traditional and Roth 401(k) retirement plans
* Lucrative Wellness Program
* Based upon employee eligibility


**Additional Information**
 SWBC is a Substance\-Free Workplace and requires pre\-employment drug testing.
   

  

 Please note, SWBC does not hire tobacco users as allowed by law.
   

  

 To learn more about SWBC, visit our website at www.SWBC.com. If interested, please click the appropriate apply button.

title: Computer Numerical Control Programmer
description:
**CNC / VMC Programmer** 




**Location:** 
 Hosur, Karnataka
 



**Function:** 
 Manufacturing / Production Engineering
 



**Experience:** 
 3–8 Years
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a skilled
 **CNC / VMC Programmer** 
 to support our advanced furniture manufacturing operations. The role will be responsible for programming, optimizing and troubleshooting CNC machining processes, ensuring accurate production of components as per design and quality requirements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and optimize
 **CNC/VMC programs** 
 for machining operations.
* Convert
 **CAD drawings/models into machine\-ready programs** 
 using CAM software.
* Work on
 **5\-axis CNC routers, VMCs and automated machining equipment** 
 .
* Create and optimize
 **toolpaths, cutting parameters, tool selection and nesting** 
 for efficient material utilization.
* Generate and validate
 **G\-code/M\-code** 
 programs and ensure error\-free machine execution.
* Interpret
 **AutoCAD/SolidWorks drawings, 3D models and manufacturing specifications** 
 .
* Support machining of
 **solid wood, engineered wood, panels and other furniture components** 
 .
* Conduct program simulations and identify potential machining or collision issues before production.
* Troubleshoot programming, tooling, machine and dimensional issues during production.
* Work closely with
 **Design, Production, Quality and Engineering teams** 
 to improve manufacturability and cycle time.
* Optimize CNC processes for
 **productivity, quality, material utilization and machine efficiency** 
 .
* Maintain CNC programs, tooling data, process sheets and relevant technical documentation.



  





**Required Skills** 



* CNC / VMC Programming
* 5\-Axis CNC Programming
* CAM Programming \& Toolpath Optimization
* G\-code / M\-code
* AutoCAD / SolidWorks
* CNC Routing \& Machining
* Nesting \& Material Optimization
* Tool Selection \& Cutting Parameters
* CNC Machine Setup \& Troubleshooting
* CAD/CAM Interpretation
* DFM \& Process Optimization
* Production \& Quality Control



  





**Qualification** 



* Diploma / ITI / B.E. / B.Tech in
 **Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing or related engineering discipline** 
 .
* 3–8 years of relevant experience in CNC/VMC programming and manufacturing.



  





**Preferred Experience** 




 Candidates with experience in
 **furniture, woodworking, modular furniture, kitchen manufacturing, panel processing, solid wood machining or highly automated manufacturing environments** 
 will be preferred.
 



 Experience with
 **5\-axis CNC routers, automated drilling, nesting and CAD\-to\-CNC workflows** 
 will be an added advantage.

title: Network Automation Solution Developer
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Network Automation Solution Developer, you will validate Service Portals and ensure their reliability for leading telecom operators. Working with agile, cross\-functional teams, you will develop and execute test strategies for orchestration, automation, and service assurance across IP/MPLS networks. You will leverage test automation tools, troubleshoot issues, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to continuous integration and delivery, helping deliver high\-quality network automation solutions.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Design and implement comprehensive end\-to\-end test strategies for Service Portals, focusing on performance and reliability.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Robot Framework for regression, functional, and system testing.
* Validate complex IP/MPLS network topologies, ensuring thorough testing of orchestration and automation functionalities.
* Troubleshoot issues, conduct root cause analysis, and collaborate with developers to drive continuous improvement.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines by integrating automated testing within the release process.
* Review and assess product requirements and design documents to ensure they meet testability standards.
* Mentor junior QA engineers, providing guidance and participating in peer reviews to enhance team skills.
* Report on quality metrics, defect tracking, and performance validation to ensure high\-quality product releases.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Telecommunications, IP Networking, or related field
* 10 years of experience in software quality assurance, with at least 2 years in the telecom/networking domain.
* Proficiency in Robot Framework, Python/Java scripting, and test automation design patterns
* Strong understanding of IP and network virtualization concepts.


**It would be nice if you also had:**
* Familiarity with Nokia NSP architecture and service provisioning (e.g., L3VPN, TE tunnels)
* Experience with Linux\-based environments, network emulators (e.g., IXIA, Spirent), and protocol analyzers (e.g., Wireshark)
* Excellent analytical, debugging, and documentation skills.


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
   

  

**About The Team**
 Some of our benefits in India:
   

  

* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements to support work–life balance
* Health and well\-being support – medical insurance for you and your family, health check\-ups, life and accident insurance, well\-being programs, and employee resource groups
* A minimum of 90 days of Maternity and Paternity Leave based on eligibility
* Personal Support Service 24/7 – a confidential support channel open to all Nokia employees and their families in challenging situations
* Career growth \& mobility – technical career paths, job rotations, international assignments, and relocation support
* Continuous learning – technical certifications, mentoring programs, coaching, and digital learning platforms
* Opportunities to innovate and contribute through Nokia’s research and development environment
* Recognition programs that celebrate outstanding contributions
* Workplace support – ergonomic working support and mobile device programs based on eligibility
